name: How long does a sewer camera inspection take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a sewer camera inspection take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sewer camera inspection can vary depending on the length and complexity of your sewer system, as well as the severity of any issues found. Typically, a standard residential inspection takes approximately one to two hours from start to finish. This includes setup, the actual camera feed, and a brief discussion of findings. More complex systems or significant blockages might require additional time for thorough assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard residential sewer camera inspection usually takes about one to two hours, depending on your system's complexity.
